Paste this into the ThisWorkbook code window (Alt+F11, double-click ThisWorkbook).
Do not import this file as a module. Excel already has a ThisWorkbook object.

Private Sub Workbook_Open()
    On Error Resume Next
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Config").Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    On Error GoTo OpenFail
    IMS_Start
    Exit Sub
OpenFail:
    MsgBox "Hardware Lab IMS did not start." & vbCrLf & Err.Description, vbCritical, "Hardware Lab IMS"
End Sub
